command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d ''; }; voice_block(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'; }; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; PRE=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$PRE"; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100 >/dev/null; echo dial_requested=true; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 40); do S=$(state); echo live_call_state=$S; if [ "$S" = "2" ]; then ACTIVE=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$ACTIVE" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; ACTIVE_AUDIO=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO"; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; echo silent_audio_guard_active=true; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity --ez run_shizuku_live_probe true >/dev/null; PID=''; for i in $(seq 1 60); do PID=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | awk '$1=="shell" && $3 ~ /call_media$/ {print $2; exit}' | tr -d ''); if [ -n "$PID" ]; then break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; echo userservice_pid=$PID; test -n "$PID"; sleep 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | awk -v p="$PID" '$1=="shell" && $2==p {found=1; print} END{exit !found}'; SYSLOG=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief); printf '%s
' "$SYSLOG" | grep -E "u/pid:2000/$PID state:started.*USAGE_CALL_ASSISTANT|USAGE_CALL_ASSISTANT.*u/pid:2000/$PID state:started" >/dev/null; echo call_assistant_active_before_kill=true; KILL_START=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic_ns())'); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell kill -9 "$PID"; GONE=0; for i in $(seq 1 100); do if ! adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o PID | grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*$PID[[:space:]]*$"; then GONE=1; break; fi; sleep 0.01; done; KILL_END=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic_ns())'); KILL_GONE_MS=$(( (KILL_END-KILL_START)/1000000 )); echo userservice_process_gone=$GONE; echo userservice_kill_to_gone_ms=$KILL_GONE_MS; test "$GONE" = "1"; FINAL=''; for i in $(seq 1 100); do FINAL=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S'); if printf '%s
' "$FINAL" | grep -Eq 'error=(service_disconnected|.*DeadObjectException|.*IOException|.*Broken pipe)'; then break; fi; sleep 0.05; done; printf '%s
' "$FINAL"; printf '%s
' "$FINAL" | grep -q 'shizuku_live_probe_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$FINAL" | grep -Eiq 'error=(service_disconnected|.*DeadObjectException|.*IOException|.*Broken pipe)'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$'; APP=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | tr -d ''); echo app_pid_after_userservice_death=$APP; test -n "$APP"; POST_AUDIO=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$POST_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$POST_AUDIO" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$POST_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; echo silent_audio_guard_after_userservice_death=true; cleanup; trap - EXIT; test "$(state)" = "0"; echo phase2d_userservice_death_silent_ok=true
